info.name: Get Amazon S3 Data Forwarding Destinations.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of data forwarding destinations returned in the response. The number of data forwarding destinations returned may be less than the `limit`.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

items.docs: Get a list of all Amazon S3 data forwarding destinations.

info.name: Create An S3 Data Forwarding Destination.

items.docs: Create a new Amazon S3 data forwarding destination.

info.name: Get An S3 Data Forwarding Destination.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the S3 data forwarding destination to return.

items.docs: Get an S3 data forwarding destination by the given identifier.

info.name: Update An S3 Data Forwarding Destination.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the data forwarding destination to update.

items.docs: Update an S3 data forwarding destination by the given identifier.

info.name: Delete An S3 Data Forwarding Destination.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the data forwarding destination to delete.

items.docs: Delete an existing Amazon S3 data forwarding destination with the given identifier.

info.name: Get All S3 Data Forwarding Rules.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of data forwarding rules returned in the response. The number of data forwarding rules returned may be less than the `limit`.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

items.docs: Get a list of all S3 data forwarding rules.

info.name: Create An S3 Data Forwarding Rule.

items.docs: Create a data forwarding rule to send data from a Partition or Scheduled View to an S3 bucket.

info.name: Get An S3 Data Forwarding Rule By Its Index.

params.name: indexId
params.description: The `id` of the Partition or Scheduled View.

items.docs: Get the details of an S3 data forwarding rule by its Partition or Scheduled View identifier.

info.name: Update An S3 Data Forwarding Rule By Its Index.

params.name: indexId
params.description: The `id` of the Partition or Scheduled View with the data forwarding rule to update.

items.docs: Update an S3 data forwarding rule by its Partition or Scheduled View identifier.

info.name: Delete An S3 Data Forwarding Rule By Its Index.

params.name: indexId
params.description: The `id` of the Partition or Scheduled View with the data forwarding rule to delete.

items.docs: Delete an S3 data forwarding rule by its Partition or Scheduled View identifier.
